import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, ipaddress
rng = random.Random(11)
def ip(x): return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x))
# ~60000 initial rows (with duplicates so active routes stay <= 30000)
routes = []
pool = []
for i in range(30000):
    st = rng.getrandbits(128) // (1 << 64) * (1 << 64)
    pool.append([ip(st) + "/64", rng.randint(0, 100)])
routes = [list(r) for r in pool] + [list(r) for r in pool]
req = {"cases": [{"initial": routes, "transactions": [], "bursts": [],
                  "cache_pages": 2, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 8, "decode": [0, 1, 2]}}]}
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
print('input bytes', len(data))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc', p.returncode, '%.1fs' % (time.time()-t), p.stdout[:40], p.stderr[:300])
EOF
